ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white internal surface area relative to 30% low-intensity black peripheral and focal pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips; left lobe exhibits vertical linear low-intensity streaks; right lobe displays a cluster of approximately 8-10 distinct circular low-intensity blobs in the medial-to-distal region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees, bisecting the two lobes at the central posterior axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; significant macro-indentation (missing tissue segment) on the upper-left trailing edge; fine-scale jagged peaks across the right lobe trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to an acute upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular clusters on the white right lobe; visible white circular markings (barnacle scars) localized on the low-intensity black area of the far-left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least four parallel vertical low-intensity marks (rake marks) on the lower-left white surface of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentation/loss of tissue on the left lobe trailing edge, likely indicative of previous trauma or predation attempt; extensive rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular white scars on the far-left black tip creating a high-contrast 'ringed' texture.
